# TDrive v2.0.1

This patch fixes Linux AppImages failing to launch when the host does not have WebKitGTK installed.

## Fixes

- Bundle GTK3, WebKitGTK 4.1, WebKit helper processes, and GTK/GIO resources alongside the existing mpv runtime.
- Check AppImage startup in an Ubuntu 22.04 container without host GTK or WebKit packages before publishing.
- Use the catalog-compatible filename `TDrive-v2.0.1-x86_64.AppImage` and update Linux asset discovery to recognize it.
- Update Markdown preview dependencies to patched versions.

## Linux upgrade

Users on v2.0.0 or earlier must upgrade manually once: download `TDrive-v2.0.1-x86_64.AppImage` from this release's **Assets**, make it executable, and launch it. Earlier versions' in-app updater expects the old filename. v2.0.1 recognizes the new filename for subsequent updates.

Existing account and drive data are retained. The Linux AppImage requires glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04 or a compatible distribution).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jeetrex17/TDrive/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1
